content.text:
The push failed again with the same error: "refusing to allow a GitHub App to create or update workflow `.github/workflows/release.yml` without `workflows` permission". The run that answered your comment started 3 seconds after it, from `main` at 1bd3673, so it used the workflow from before 96fe882. Its App token didn't request `permission-workflows: write`. Re-running this run won't help, because a re-run uses the same workflow version.

**Ready to push on the next run**:
- **The workflow:** `.github/workflows/release.yml`, the same file as in my earlier comment.
- **A docs fix:** `CONTRIBUTING.md` links to `release.yml` again, now that the file is there.

`npm run check` passed with both changes.

I committed them locally, but the push failed. So I undid the commits and left the changes uncommitted, because pi-action saves uncommitted files to the thread and the next run will restore them. Commits that were only on this runner would have been lost.

**Next step:** post another `@pi` comment on this PR, now that `main` is at 96fe882. That run will commit both changes and push them to `chore/release-2.3.0`.

If that push is rejected too, the App installation probably doesn't have the Workflows permission yet. Turn it on in the App's settings, then accept the new permission on the installation under the repository or org settings.
